userStories.title: Admin Layout & Grouped Navigation
userStories.description: Refactor AdminLayout into 6 grouped categories with responsive sidebar and standardized JHS GLOBAL branding
acceptanceCriteria: Admin navigation is organized into 6 clear operational groups: Commercial Sales, Commodity Catalogue, Compliance & Trust, Content CMS, AI Desk, Governance & Settings
Brand string is standardized to 'JHS GLOBAL' throughout navigation and layout
Mobile topbar and sliding responsive drawer work smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
Active route styling and breadcrumbs accurately indicate current location

userStories.title: Server-Side RBAC & Audit Logging
userStories.description: Implement AuditLog Sequelize model and server-side RBAC authorization verification
acceptanceCriteria: AuditLog Sequelize model created in server/src/modules/audit/auditLog.model.js and registered in models/index.js
Audit log helper utility logs mutations with sanitized before/after snapshots and IP addresses
Role authorization middleware strictly enforces access rules for admin, sales, editor, and viewer roles

userStories.title: Core Admin Component Kit & Skeletons
userStories.description: Build and test reusable admin component kit: DataTable, FilterBar, StatusBadge, DetailDrawer, FormKit, and Skeletons
acceptanceCriteria: DataTable component supports sorting, pagination, empty states, and selection
FilterBar component supports debounced search and status pills
StatusBadge component pairs status color tokens with icons and accessible text
DetailDrawer component provides slide-out drawer with focus trap and unsaved changes warning
Admin skeleton loaders prevent layout shift during queries
Component kit unit tests pass with 100% success
